thesis: The speaker argues that the barrier between having an idea and shipping working software is collapsing because AI agents can now write code, expanding the addressable audience for development tools from 17 million professional developers to approximately three billion people who can use spreadsheets. Consequently, the concept of 'agent experience' has become essential for products, particularly in developer tools, as these new users are not developers but rather marketers, designers, and product managers who interact with software through autonomous AI agents.
